q: The layer of the atmosphere that contains about 75% of its mass and in which nearly all living things and human activity occur is the _____
e: The layer of the atmosphere that contains about 75% of its mass and in which nearly all living things and human activity occur is the troposphere. The troposphere is the lowest layer, where almost all weather and living things are. Stratosphere would fill a different blank than troposphere.

q: Dry air contains approximately _____ nitrogen by volume.
e: Dry air contains approximately 78% nitrogen by volume. 78% is the idea that completes this fact. 21% would fill a different blank than 78%.

q: The concentration of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere has increased from _____ to its present value of 0.04%.
e: The concentration of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere has increased from 0.03% to its present value of 0.04%. 0.03% is the idea that completes this fact. 0.05% would fill a different blank than 0.03%.

q: Oxygen is the reactive part of the air and is involved in all of the following EXCEPT _____
e: Oxygen is the reactive part of the air and is involved in all of the following EXCEPT photosynthesis. Photosynthesis uses chlorophyll to trap light and build sugar from carbon dioxide and water. Respiration would fill a different blank than photosynthesis.

q: In the process of respiration, glucose reacts with oxygen to produce carbon dioxide, water, and _____
e: In the process of respiration, glucose reacts with oxygen to produce carbon dioxide, water, and energy. Your body uses oxygen from air with food to release energy. ATP would fill a different blank than energy.

q: Green plants need carbon dioxide for _____
e: Green plants need carbon dioxide for photosynthesis. Photosynthesis uses chlorophyll to trap light and build sugar from carbon dioxide and water. Respiration would fill a different blank than photosynthesis.

q: During fractional distillation of liquid air, the gas that boils off first is _____
e: During fractional distillation of liquid air, the gas that boils off first is nitrogen. Nitrogen is the idea that completes this fact. Oxygen would fill a different blank than nitrogen.

q: In the fractional distillation of air, water vapour and carbon dioxide are removed early because they would otherwise _____
e: In the fractional distillation of air, water vapour and carbon dioxide are removed early because they would otherwise freeze and block the pipes. Freeze and block the pipes is the idea that completes this fact. Form acids would fill a different blank than freeze and block the pipes.

q: Which of the following is NOT one of the six main air pollutants listed in the textbook?
e: Carbon dioxide is the option that does not belong with the rest. Carbon dioxide is the idea that completes this fact. Carbon monoxide is among the listed items, so it is not the exception.

q: Carbon monoxide is dangerous because it _____
a: reacts with haemoglobin and prevents oxygen transport
e: Carbon monoxide is dangerous because it reacts with haemoglobin and prevents oxygen transport. Oxygen supports respiration and combustion, and it is a very reactive non-metal. Causes acid rain would fill a different blank than reacts with haemoglobin and prevents oxygen transport.

q: Sulphur dioxide contributes to _____
e: Sulphur dioxide contributes to acid rain. Acid rain forms when sulfur and nitrogen oxides make acidic solutions in rain. Global warming would fill a different blank than acid rain.

q: Methane is considered a greenhouse gas because it _____
e: Methane is considered a greenhouse gas because it traps heat in the atmosphere. The atmosphere is the layer of air around Earth, split into troposphere, stratosphere, mesosphere, and thermosphere. Depletes the ozone layer would fill a different blank than traps heat in the atmosphere.

q: Ground-level ozone is formed by the reaction of nitrogen oxides with _____ in the presence of sunlight.
e: Ground-level ozone is formed by the reaction of nitrogen oxides with unburnt hydrocarbons in the presence of sunlight. A hydrocarbon contains only hydrogen and carbon. Sulphur dioxide would fill a different blank than unburnt hydrocarbons.

q: The greenhouse effect refers to the trapping of _____ by gases like carbon dioxide and methane.
e: The greenhouse effect refers to the trapping of infrared radiation by gases like carbon dioxide and methane. Infrared radiation is the idea that completes this fact. Ultraviolet radiation would fill a different blank than infrared radiation.

q: Which of the following is a natural source of methane?
e: Bacterial decay of vegetable matter is a natural source of methane. Bacterial decay of vegetable matter is the idea that completes this fact. Volcanic eruptions is not a natural source of methane.

q: Acid rain is defined as rain water with a pH less than _____
e: Acid rain is defined as rain water with a pH less than 5.0. 5.0 is the idea that completes this fact. 5.7 would fill a different blank than 5.0.

q: Naturally slightly acidic rain (pH ≈ 5.7) is due to carbon dioxide forming _____
e: Naturally slightly acidic rain (pH ≈ 5.7) is due to carbon dioxide forming carbonic acid. Carbonic acid is the idea that completes this fact. Nitric acid would fill a different blank than carbonic acid.

q: The chemical reaction $2SO_2(g) + O_2(g) + 2H_2O(l) \rightarrow 2H_2SO_4(aq)$ represents the formation of _____
e: The chemical reaction 2SO2(g) + O2(g) + 2H2O(l) to 2H2SO4(aq) represents the formation of sulphuric acid. Sulphuric acid is the idea that completes this fact. Nitric acid would fill a different blank than sulphuric acid.

q: Liquid nitrogen is used to _____
e: Liquid nitrogen is used to quick-freeze food. Quick-freeze food is the idea that completes this fact. Produce oxyacetylene flames would fill a different blank than quick-freeze food.

q: Helium is used to fill balloons because it is very light and _____
e: Helium is used to fill balloons because it is very light and inert. Inert is the idea that completes this fact. Dense would fill a different blank than inert.
